mapper.select: /*commonMdCmBasePriceApproval.selectBasePriceApprList*/ SELECT TO_CHAR(ROWNUM) AS NO ,A.CMS_CATLG_ID ,A.DESCRIPTION_LOC ,A.MODEL_INFO ,A.SPECIFICATION ,A.MAKER_NAME ,A.ORDER_MEASURE ,A.RE_BASE_PRICE_VIEW ,A.CH_BASE_PRICE_VIEW ,A.CH_BASE_PRICE_TYPE_NM ,A.DOWN_RATE ,A.CHANGE_REASON FROM ( SELECT D.CMS_CATLG_ID ,C.DESCRIPTION_LOC ,C.MODEL_INFO ,C.SPECIFICATION ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M104' AND CODE = C.MAKER_CODE) AS MAKER_NAME ,C.ORDER_MEASURE ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(D.RE_BASE_PRICE, 'FM999,999,999,990')) AS RE_BASE_PRICE_VIEW ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(D.CH_BASE_PRICE, 'FM999,999,999,990')) AS CH_BASE_PRICE_VIEW ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M183' AND CODE = D.CH_BASE_PRICE_TYPE) AS CH_BASE_PRICE_TYPE_NM ,CASE WHEN NVL(D.RE_BASE_PRICE,0) = 0 THEN '' ELSE TRIM(TO_CHAR(ROUND((D.RE_BASE_PRICE - D.CH_BASE_PRICE) / D.RE_BASE_PRICE * 100, 1), 'FM990.0')) || '%' END AS DOWN_RATE ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M184' AND CODE = D.BASE_PRICE_CHANGE_REASON) AS CHANGE_REASON ,D.PM_SEQ FROM KEPMGPDT D, CMSCATLG C WHERE D.CMS_CATLG_ID = C.CMS_CATLG_ID AND D.BUYER = #{KEY_2} AND D.PM_NO = #{DOCU_NO} ORDER BY D.PM_SEQ ) A

/*commonMdCmBasePriceApproval.selectBasePriceReqDtList*/ SELECT D.CMS_CATLG_ID ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(D.CH_BASE_PRICE)) AS CH_BASE_PRICE ,D.CH_BASE_PRICE_TYPE ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M183' AND CODE = D.CH_BASE_PRICE_TYPE) AS CH_BASE_PRICE_TYPE_NM ,D.BASE_PRICE_CHANGE_REASON FROM KEPMGPDT D WHERE D.BUYER = #{KEY_2} AND D.PM_NO = #{KEY_1} ORDER BY D.PM_SEQ
